narrative.overview:
This is a PROPOSED OWNER MOBILE MOCKUP, not approved global Nevora design authority. The foundation and Schedule work is an ordinary extension of Jose’s approved modern, clean, premium Gusto/Homebase direction, retaining the NEVORA wordmark, teal identity, system type and Phosphor icons. No taste score or replacement brand metaphor is established.

Canonical source is `work/owner-mobile/template.html`, `styles.css`, `schedule.css`, `app.js` and `schedule.js`; `build.py` embeds these five files into `outputs/nevora-owner-mobile.html`. The earlier `work/build_mockup.py` and `work/refine_v2.py` are historical. The stage boundary is `work/schedule-mobile/brief.md`; final verification is recorded separately in `outputs/schedule-review-results.md`. The feature catalog records route and capability boundaries; it does not establish authorization. This document does not authorize application changes or replace the production DESIGN.MD.

The later four-comment mobile control refinement is recorded separately in `outputs/mobile-controls-polish.md`; the earlier Schedule-stage report retains its frozen source hash.

The subsequent Home detail refinement has separate evidence in `outputs/home-polish.md`. Earlier reports remain frozen to their own artifact hashes.

The later single Team header action refinement is recorded in `outputs/team-action-polish.md`.

The later select and published-change refinement is recorded in `outputs/shift-form-polish.md`.

The coverage-rules and checkbox refinement is recorded in `outputs/coverage-rules-polish.md`.
keyCharacteristics: System typography and consumed spacing roles across five owner destinations.
Teal actions and selection; amber coverage and red attendance states carry text and icons.
Grouped tools, adaptive navigation and explicit return context.
Compact day/week browsing and focused Schedule reviews using the existing control and surface roles.
Centered date controls, a labeled compact Schedule primary action and neutral section counts reuse the existing shared roles.
Home uses a restrained staffing summary, a plain teal coverage calendar, unit-bearing text totals and a two-line upcoming-arrival row; Schedule keeps its count badges.
Team Add employee and Schedule Add shift share one labeled compact primary action, centered with the heading and wrapping at enlarged text.
Native single selects share an inset Phosphor chevron; the published-change review is separated from Notes with a neutral notice and unchanged required consent.
Coverage periods have clear section spacing and full-width Add/Save with subordinate Remove; native checkbox inputs share a22px box,4px corners and the existing Phosphor check.
Selected-day people use aligned wrapping rows and a native disclosure with the shared Phosphor chevron.
rules: Owner mobile Schedule notices use a neutral canvas/line surface, dark heading, muted supporting text, 16px padding and a 20px Phosphor icon with 12px gap. Published-week status uses a muted calendar; real cautions retain amber warning-circle. Preserve all consequence text and required approvals; keep validation errors red. Scoped evidence: outputs/schedule-notice-polish.md.

Coverage entry-point icons share the Home teal calendar-blank cue without a colored tile or cancellation mark. Inbox/Updates keep a 40px transparent alignment box around the 22px icon; preserve text columns, counts and destinations. Evidence: outputs/inbox-coverage-polish.md.

Draft is a neutral lifecycle status: use tab-track/muted roles at weight 600 with 4px/8px badge padding and 8px corners. Published retains teal/teal-wash. Preserve explicit status words and publication behavior. Evidence: outputs/draft-status-polish.md.

Owner mobile Team profiles/editors preserve the existing visual world: full mobile pages, readable definition rows, separate Details/Scheduling saves, sticky task navigation and deliberate review. Native radios distinguish management scope from location checkboxes. Draft/version retention, stable person identity and explicit consequences are required; creation is not an invitation. Evidence: outputs/owner-team-review.md.

Owner mobile invitation status, review and results reuse Team components. Separate invitation validity, delivery and activation; masked fixed recipient,15-minute expiry, replacement/revoke consequences, original-operation recovery. Evidence: outputs/owner-invitations-review.md; source SHA256 f5f988d8166320f9d549c28b3f6e99f6d19f774181541e9580bc31e3b1e7f7c0.

Owner mobile Manager access inherits Team/invitation components: one Manager-only profile entry, explicit scope choices, reviewed assignment/revocation, collapsed history and whole-word enlarged-text headers. Preserve original-command recovery and live clean-status refresh. Evidence: outputs/owner-manager-access-review.md; SHA256 ad6fa49fd55dc123cae7122b8fe651ab2325e71c860cd39da36b72b748fa7e79.

Owner mobile Clocker PIN inherits existing Team/form roles: status, consequence review before digits, two masked four-digit fields and metadata-only result/recovery. Scope sticky-header clearance to the form; never expose existing PIN or imply UUID replay. Evidence outputs/owner-clocker-pin-review.md; SHA256 3bc2e7b29d0eaba60fdbefc028b09d8faef225125cf3a20d6ab6571cc122093c.

Owner mobile account recovery continues Team task/identity/form/review primitives: full-width native textarea, full preset attestation disclosure, invalid sample-code handoff, measured label-aware focus and distinct cleared/hidden/expired/unconfirmed states. Scope/evidence: outputs/owner-account-recovery-review.md; no global design change.

Owner mobile Team audit retains the established design system: contextual duplicate-name IDs, measured validation focus, exact person-hour anchor and native five-rule operational review with explicit applicability and an atomic independent save. Uncertain retained entries never imply rollback. Scope/evidence: outputs/owner-team-audit.md.
dos: Do treat these values as a proposal scoped to the isolated Owner Mobile mockup.
Do preserve the NEVORA wordmark, teal identity and semantic attention colors.
Do use the canonical source roles and retain focus, text resizing and reduced-motion behavior.
Do distinguish a sample decision or preview from a verified staffing check or real operation.
donts: Don’t promote the proposal to approved global Nevora authority without review.
Don’t recreate stale V2 overrides, duplicate control-radius tokens or fixed navigation-height assumptions.
Don’t claim production verification, formal accessibility certification or a Tastemaker score from this record.
